usable_principles: Fresh current-byte plan with narrow target scope
Preserve native unknown outcomes; do not infer completion from empty temporary state
Per-batch byte precondition and complete-byte readback

required_FX3_work.work: Complete current-session identity/protocol/exit plan and normal-parent USB cached association. Active access requires separate authorization.

Capture and authenticate healthy same-body originals for every proposed affected file/setting plus dependencies. Official samples are not same-body originals; A7C II two-program/name inventory does not cover an FX3 av-cam candidate.
Bind actual worker/ABI/path/owner/epoch/locks and all consumers/code exits, with restricted exact-byte restoration and readback.
Verify current WBI backend/retained-image semantics, effective loaded state, physical cold start and unchanged modes.
Demonstrate an independent recoverable entry/fault envelope before relying on recovery for persistent changes; do not induce a brick.
Verify real HD29.97 HEVC42010~16M MAIN, audio/timestamps/mux/query/cache consistency, long recording and temperature.
